title: Hair & Makeup by Gerta | Hair Stylist & Makeup Artist – Staten Island, NY
description: Gerta Lila, hair stylist and makeup artist at Le Vigne Hair Salon, Staten Island, NY. Balayage, color, cuts, keratin, Brazilian blowouts and natural makeup.
h1: Hair Stylist and Makeup Artist in Staten Island, NY

hero.welcome: Welcome to HairByGerta.com. I’m Gerta Lila, a hair stylist and makeup artist in Staten Island, NY. I create fresh cuts, color, extensions and soft, flattering makeup that highlight your natural beauty and last all day.

photo_row.alt_original: Smiling client with long dark styled hair

meet.heading: Meet Gerta
meet.paragraph_1: I offer makeup that looks natural, photographs beautifully, and lasts all day. Whether it’s a party, photoshoot, or any special event, I create the perfect look so you feel confident and beautiful throughout your special day.

portrait.alt_original: Makeup artist applies  eye shadow   Beautiful woman face Hand of visagiste, painting  cos

meet.paragraph_2: I work with high-quality hair extensions that blend naturally with your own hair, so they look and move like the real thing. I choose the right products and at-home care so you can keep your look fresh and polished long after you leave the chair.

large.alt_original: Stylist checking the blend of a client's hair extensions

blocks.text: Hi, I’m Gerta Lila, a hair stylist and makeup artist. You’ll find me at Le Vigne Hair Salon, 644 Forest Ave in Staten Island, where I’ve worked for about seven years. I love getting to know each client, listening to what you want and creating a look that feels like you, only more polished. Whether you want a small change or something completely new, I’ll be honest about what will work for your hair and help you get there.

blocks.html: Balayage and color: I hand-paint balayage for a soft, sun-kissed finish and mix custom color for anything from a gentle refresh to a full change. Highlights and lowlights add brightness and depth right where you want them.
Cuts and layers: A good cut makes everyday styling easy. I shape layers that suit your face and the way you really wear your hair, and I’ll show you how to style it at home.
Keratin and Brazilian blowout: If frizz fights you every morning, a keratin treatment or a Brazilian blowout leaves your hair smoother, shinier and easier to manage.
Hair extensions: I work with high-quality extensions that blend with your own hair, for more length, more volume or both. I’ll also show you how to care for them so they stay looking fresh.

Bridal and event hair and makeup: For weddings, parties, photoshoots and special events, I do hair and makeup that photographs beautifully and lasts all day, so you can relax and enjoy the moment. Bring photos of looks you love and we’ll plan yours together.

The easiest way is to call or text me at 347-671-5095, or send me a message on Instagram or Facebook. I’m at the salon Tuesday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Prices are set by the salon, so just ask when you book. I look forward to seeing you in my chair here in Staten Island!
